vulnerabilities.actualResult: DETECTED — "SQL Injection (discovered parameter \"search\" on /api/users)", CRITICAL, confidence:high, real evidence
vulnerabilities.notes: Initially MISSED on the first real scan: server/redTeam/sqlInjection.ts's/server/paramFuzzer.ts's SQL_ERROR_SIGNATURE regex had no pattern matching better-sqlite3's actual raw error text ("near \"X\": syntax error") — it only had "SQLite3::"/"SQLiteException", which are PHP/Java driver class-name prefixes that never appear in a real Node app. Fixed in this session (both files) and re-verified detecting.

vulnerabilities.actualResult: DETECTED — "Reflected XSS (discovered parameter \"name\" on /profile)", HIGH, confidence:high, real evidence. Worked on the very first scan, no fix needed.
DETECTED — "Stored XSS (discovered form field \"text\" on /api/comments)", CRITICAL, confidence:high, real evidence
vulnerabilities.notes: Initially MISSED: server/storedXss.ts only re-checked the form's action URL and the site root for the persisted payload — never the page the form was actually found ON, which for a REST-style split (form on /post/1, action /api/comments) is neither. Added InjectableTarget.discoveredOnPage (stamped by server/crawler.ts's extractForms) and had displayCandidates() include it; re-verified detecting. Also had to fix a fixture bug: the form had no postId field, so the crawler's raw POST (bypassing this page's own onsubmit JS) 400'd before ever storing anything.

vulnerabilities.actualResult: DETECTED — "Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA)", CRITICAL, confidence:high, real evidence. Worked on the very first scan (with bolaIdentities supplied), no fix needed.

NOT DETECTED (confirmed gap) — no finding about the token itself. Seclayer has no probe that captures multiple tokens and analyzes them for a predictable pattern. The insecure cookie flags (httpOnly:false, secure:false) were NOT separately flagged either in this run — worth a closer look at whether the cookie-flag check ran against this specific cookie.

NOT DETECTED (confirmed gap) — the fixed-path 'Exposed User Object Endpoint' probe only checks /api/v1/users/admin, not arbitrary admin paths, and there is no generic 'authenticated-but-unauthorized' detector for custom endpoints.
NOT DETECTED (confirmed gap) — SAST secret-signature scanning (server/passiveScan.ts's analyzeSecrets) only ever runs over the root page's HTML, never crawled sub-pages or JSON API responses.
